problems.reason: Sentence 14 states Ornithomimus edmontonicus is the type species, while sentence 7 says the type species is Ornithomimus velox.
Sentence 17 gives a time range of 83.6–66 Ma, whereas sentence 18 limits the range to 70–66 Ma.
Both sentences claim the dinosaur had bird‑like skulls.
